<!-- CONTRIBUTING.md (Pull requests, Review) says what goes here and how this is reviewed. -->

What changed and why.

## Checks

The commands from CONTRIBUTING.md (Checks) that ran, and their results.

## Measurements

For a change to rendering, the runtime or the request path (CONTRIBUTING.md, Pull requests,
item 2): the tool, the build, the runs, and the median and range before and after. Otherwise,
none. A change to work around the handler also says which way it is decided, on a line of its
own: `Request path: counted` or `Request path: measured`.

## Review

Who reviewed it against the values (README.md, Values), and each finding with what was done
about it. A review that found nothing says so, and what it could not check.
